hints.title: Post-Order Filtering
hints.text: A node must be deleted if every single root-to-leaf path passing through it has a total sum less than limit. Evaluate child subtrees bottom-up.

hints.title: Leaf Boundary Base Case
hints.text: For a leaf node, compare its value against remaining limit. If node.val is strictly less than limit, delete it by returning null.

hints.title: Child Pruning and Deletion
hints.text: Recursively filter left and right children with limit - node.val. If both children were pruned away to null, the current node has no valid paths left and must also be deleted.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing paths independently re-evaluates overlapping nodes and incurs O(N * H) overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Post-order DFS visits each tree node once in O(N) time with O(H) recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle leaf base cases properly and delete internal nodes whose children are both pruned.
complexity.notes: Root itself can be pruned if all root-to-leaf paths are insufficient.
